cmad.notes: CMAD expected for operational NASA mission but not located. GOLD has no StopDate, is a NASA Heliophysics Explorer Mission of Opportunity, and was reviewed in the 2023 Heliophysics Senior Review (https://science.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/final-2023-senior-review-report-tagged.pdf), whose GOLD section does not mention a CMAD. Searched: (a) no designated CMAD repository is configured; Zenodo searched anyway (no GOLD CMAD); (b) the GOLD Science Data Center documentation at UCF and the CDAWeb GOLD documentation directory (https://cdaweb.gsfc.nasa.gov/sp_phys/data/gold/documentation/), which hold the Public Science Data Products Guide Rev 5.2 (January 2026), release notes, a data-issues table and a November 2026 notice, but no CMAD; (c) two web-search passes ('GOLD CMAD', 'GOLD Calibration and Measurement Algorithms Document') returned only NASA's generic HPD CMAD template. The data products guide carries no front-page author list, so it was not treated as CMAD evidence. Current-team evidence came instead from the GOLD science team page.
